title: docs(app-shell): shrink UNGATED_DOCS by one — the app-shell README's 11 blocks compile honestly (#5174 batch 11)
body:
Part of #5174 (batch 11).

`packages/app-shell/README.md`'s 11 `ts`/`tsx` blocks now compile against the built `dist`, so its `UNGATED_DOCS` entry is removed. **Ledger 28 to 27, removals only.**

⛔ No block was weakened to get there, and **no fragment marker was added** — the declared-fragment count is unchanged at 157. Every block earned its coverage by compiling.

## What the entry was hiding

Re-measured on `0246d116e` with the gate's own `analyze`, the entry's text reproduced exactly: **1 parse diagnostic + 14 undefined-name diagnostics** across 6 blocks (4 of the 11 already compiled).

**The 14 undefined names** were host-provided: `MySidebar`, `myDataSource`, `dashboardSchema`, `YourSidebar`, `YourHeader`, `children`, `dataSource`, plus the component names the blocks always implied but never imported. They are now declared against the **shipped** types with the `declare const` pattern `packages/data-objectstack/README.md` and `packages/plugin-view/README.md` already use — `DataSource` and `DashboardComponentSchema` from `@object-ui/types`, `ReactNode` from `react`.

**The 1 parse diagnostic** was this, fenced `ts`:

```
// packages/app-shell/src/runtime-config.ts
branding.stage: 'preview' | 'beta' | 'ga'  // default: 'preview'
```

That is not TypeScript — `branding.stage` is a member expression, so it cannot be a label, and it fails with TS1005. Rather than re-fence it as prose, it is now a real excerpt that restates the union **against the shipped `PlatformStage`**, so retiring or misspelling a member fails the block instead of rotting silently.

⚠️ Worth stating because batch 9 and #7426 both hit the opposite case: this block genuinely *failed to parse*. It is **not** the labelled-block-statement trap, where a brace-wrapped object literal fenced `ts` compiles green under any spelling whatsoever. Checked for that shape here and it is absent.

## Evidence

**Gate, before and after** (exit 0 both sides; the gate's own printed verdict lines):

| | before `0246d116e` | after `00fa2407f` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| documents scanned | 227 | 227 |
| covered | 199 (97 with a ts/tsx block) | **200 (98)** |
| ungated | 28 | **27** |
| covered blocks | 589 | **600** |
| to compile | 432 | **443** |
| declared fragments | 157 | **157** |
| semantic phase | 432 of 432 judged, 0 failed | **443 of 443 judged, 0 failed** |

**Invariants diffed programmatically, not by eye.** `origin/main`'s copy of the gate was imported alongside this branch's and both evaluated over the *same* working tree, so the covered-set delta is attributable to the ledger alone:

```
LEDGER entry count: 28 -> 27
ADDED entries: []
REMOVED entries: [packages/app-shell/README.md]
surviving entries whose REASON TEXT changed: []
COVERED documents: 199 -> 200  STRICTLY GROWS: true
previously-covered docs now UNGATED: []
blocks to compile: 432 -> 443
build filters: 26 -> 26, ADDED [], REMOVED []
```

Removals proved independently: `git diff --numstat` on the gate file reads **`0 2`** — zero additions. Strictness proved byte for byte: everything from the `Fence scanning` banner to EOF is identical on both sides, 794 lines, sha256 `d203debfa0073ccdb527a08e1e191b2d04b4cc00c5303ee27d4bfc76d09c7241`.

**Six probes, direction predicted in writing before each run, all six matched.** Each mutation proved on disk by anchored counts plus a blob hash differing from `HEAD`; each restore proved by `git diff HEAD` empty **and** the blob hash equal to the `HEAD` blob, never inferred from a trap's exit code.

| probe | mutation | predicted | observed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `sidebar` to `sidebarr` on `AppShell` | RED | TS2322 `Property 'sidebarr' does not exist ... Did you mean 'sidebar'?` |
| 2 | `'launched'` added to the `PlatformStage` restatement | RED | TS2322 `Type '"launched"' is not assignable to type 'PlatformStage'` |
| 3 | wrong prop on `ObjectView` | **GREEN** | green — see below |
| 4 | wrong prop on `DashboardView` | RED | TS2322 `Property 'dataSourceX' does not exist ...` |
| 5 | import a non-existent `PageViewX` | RED | TS2724 `has no exported member named 'PageViewX'` |
| 6 | a prop passed to `PageView` | RED | TS2322 `Property 'unexpectedProp' does not exist on type 'IntrinsicAttributes'` |

Probe 5 was predicted RED **as TS2305**; the direction matched but TypeScript issued the more specific TS2724. Recorded as observed rather than as predicted.

## ⭐ Probe 3 was predicted GREEN — the limit of this coverage, published rather than left unknown

`ObjectView`'s shipped signature is `ObjectView({ dataSource, objects, onEdit, externalRefreshKey }: any)` — its **whole props parameter is `any`**, so a misspelled prop name on that one block raises nothing. Its block therefore buys export-existence and JSX well-formedness, not prop checking.

Probes 4 and 6 bound that precisely: `DashboardView`'s props are *also* `dataSource?: any`, but because the parameter is an *object type* rather than bare `any`, excess-property checking still fires. So the gap is this signature's, not the gate's.

Blind spot then **discharged rather than left open**: `ObjectView` is the only component in this document whose props parameter is bare `any` — `AppShell` (`AppShellProps`), `DashboardView`, `PageView`, `DashboardRenderer` (`DashboardRendererProps`) and `PreviewBadge` (`PreviewBadgeProps`) all carry real types, and probes 1, 4 and 6 show three of them rejecting a wrong key. Filed as #7483.

## Sibling gates and the rest, all at `00fa2407f`

`check:doc-fences` exit 0 (the walk-equality pin that couples it to this gate — 227 documents, same walk) · `check:doc-types` exit 0 · `check-control-bytes` exit 0, plus a manual `grep -naP` over the C0 set on both changed files, no hits · `check-readme-exports` exit 0 (**412 of 412 self-imports real, 0 wrong-path, 0 fabricated** — independent confirmation the new imports name genuinely shipped exports).

**Changeset: checked at the gate, not assumed** — precisely because `packages/app-shell/README.md` *does* ship inside the package's `files`. `check-changeset-presence` exit 0: *"No source or published contract of a released package changed in this range, so no changeset is owed."* Verdict followed; none added.

**Tests** from the repo root (never `pnpm --filter ... exec vitest`), `--maxWorkers=2`, exit 0: **13 files, 481 tests passed**. Selection derived by `git grep -l` for the gate's name, `UNGATED_DOCS`, and the edited document, plus the sibling README gate. ⚠️ **Declared narrowing:** `@object-ui/app-shell`'s own suite was *not* run — this diff edits **zero lines of app-shell source**, README only, so no app-shell runtime behaviour is reachable from it. That is a reasoned exclusion, not an unrun suite reported as passing.

**Lint** `pnpm run lint:root` exit 0, `32 problems (0 errors, 32 warnings)`, all pre-existing. **Not a narrowing — run whole**: the population read from eslint's own `--format json` is 237 files of which 0 are `.md`/`.mdx`; the changed file in that population reports `errorCount 0 warningCount 0`; and `eslint.config.js` sets no `project` / `projectService` / `tsconfigRootDir`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move the verdict on a file it does not touch.

## Scope

Touched: `packages/app-shell/README.md` and, inside `UNGATED_DOCS` only, `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`. The ledger's docblock prose and the ownership-map comment beside it are untouched (asserted above: no surviving entry's reason text changed).

⛔ **Not touched, ruled previously:** `packages/plugin-gantt/README.md` (18 blocks — the largest remaining entry) and `packages/plugin-kanban/README.md`, both owned by #7302 / `PARTIAL_EXCERPTS`. ⛔ Not touched: `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, which is batch 10's document — this batch runs in parallel with it on the removals-only condition, and holds to it: zero additions to the ledger.

Draft, not enqueued, auto-merge not enabled. `Part of #5174` — the card outlives this batch.
